authority: The operator explicitly paused the CLK007 solar-input wait and authorized a separate Galileo Earth-satellite observable connection under unchanged CLK002 action and physical time. This is one bounded observation-contract investigation, not empirical or microscopic admission.
question: Can the fixed CLK002 action be mapped to the actual Galileo Earth-satellite clock estimator, with its pre-applied relativistic corrections separated from independently testable residuals, and do public clock/orbit/calibration/error products suffice for a joint Earth free-fall comparison?

scope.action: CLK002 EM-only massless unscreened scalar effective action, full material sensitivities, inserted 3+1 metric spacetime and proper time are unchanged.
scope.original_observable: Preserve the same-location Rb87/Cs133 ratio and its exact same-source mean-acceleration normalization. No Galileo number is substituted into that observable.
scope.new_observable: Investigate the phase/frequency comparison of a Galileo hydrogen clock and its actual ground time reference, with exact source/species/time/units and processing role to be established from primary records before empirical use.
scope.domain: First-response static spherical weak-field exterior only where the CLK002 assumptions apply. Moving clocks sample this background in metric proper time. Actual multipoles, tides, orbit fitting, link propagation and nonlinear remainders must be audited, not silently set to zero.
scope.limits: No lattice, cutoff, volume or continuum limit; no new Hamiltonian, scalar potential, clock species fitting or physical retiming.
scope.calibration: Separate bare gravitational parameter, composition-dependent dynamical calibration, fitted orbit parameters, conventionally corrected clock product, and residual estimator response. Treat actual analysis response as unknown until source supported.
scope.freefall: Existing Earth TiAlV/PtRh comparison inputs are reference-only at their established scope. No atom/element proxy replaces full source and alloy sensitivities.

workstreams: Inspect Delva2018 and Herrmann2018 primary methods and actual public GREAT product metadata/files; preserve retrieval hashes and distinguish announcement, analysis output and raw data.

Derive phase/proper-time and link observation identities, then isolate the conditional radial response and actual processing transfer. Do not equate an absolute clock response with the old ratio contrast.
Independently check sign, factor, unit, normalization, nuisance projection, zero-coupling and degenerate cases without empirical fitting.
Judge theory-map definition, actual estimator identifiability, coverage/error sufficiency, and microscopic relevance separately.

data_roles.test_fixtures: Only exact algebra/processing checks directly needed by the question; never observations.
data_roles.unknown_errors: Retain unknown values. Published standard uncertainty is not a certified total worst-case bound.

acceptance: A source-located observation map and an explicit judgment on whether the actual public estimator/calibration/error inputs suffice. Conditional algebra alone is not empirical admission. A missing link must be expressed as one precise next evidence question, not another repeated solar-owner search.
falsifier: An internal sign/domain/normalization contradiction rejects the proposed map. An absent product, processing ambiguity or missing remainder does not refute the experiment or CLK002.
non_claims: No physical Pre-A, Sector-A/B, spacetime, QFT, gravity, horizon, continuum, mass gap or TOE derivation
No observational exclusion, detection or prospective prediction without full admission
No identification of a GR-conditioned data product with theory-independent raw evidence
